verdict.rationale: Kimi documents agents that run multi-step work on their own: the CLI can "autonomously complete development tasks", the help center covers an Agent mode and Agent clusters, and the homepage invites users to start an "Agent 任务" (Agent task). The evidence never says these tasks run asynchronously in the background, nor that results come back in a review or approval step; the scheduled-tasks entry describes a recurring schedule, which is a different capability from delegating a one-off task. Missing for 10: documented background or asynchronous execution, a hand-back-for-review workflow, details beyond help-center topic titles, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegated autonomous tasks.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can delegate a multi-step task that the assistant works on autonomously in the background and returns for my review
